content.text: {"class": "PRODUCT_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The contract requires summing line items at full precision and rounding HALF_UP exactly once, but the debug logs show Money.of() rounding each line item individually (50.005->50.00, 49.995->49.99) before summation, yielding 99.99 instead of 100.00. This behaviour was introduced by billing-service commit 4e8bb07 'refactor: centralise rounding in Money.of()' between the last green build #1841 and the failing build, while the test code was last touched in March and is unchanged. The test's expectation of 100.00 is correct per the contract, so the defect is in the application."}
